skill.name: deployment-validation-config-validate
skill.description: Validate deployment configuration files, schemas, environment rules, tests, migrations, secure handling, and documentation.

skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown fences, template literals, validation examples, and test descriptions. Real risks remain because examples scan .env files, watch local config paths, emit full configuration objects, and use a fixed encryption salt. No prompt injection language or network exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval and path allowlists before reading .env files. Redact values and report only file paths and rule names.
Scope watchers to explicit files, close watchers on shutdown, and reject broad or user-untrusted paths.

remediation.issue: Full configuration objects in change events
remediation.suggestion: Emit redacted diffs or changed key names instead of oldConfig and newConfig values.

remediation.issue: Fixed salt for password-derived encryption keys
remediation.suggestion: Use a random per-value salt stored with ciphertext. Restrict accepted algorithms instead of trusting input metadata.

content.value_statement: Configuration errors can break deployments and expose secrets. This skill helps create schemas, checks, tests, migrations, and documentation.
actual_capabilities: Find likely configuration files and classify environment names.
Draft JSON Schema validation rules with Ajv examples.
Create environment checks for development, staging, and production.
Suggest tests for valid and invalid configuration values.
Outline migration patterns for versioned configuration changes.
Generate configuration reference documentation from schemas.
limitations: Does not run validation unless the agent implements or executes generated code.
Requires project-specific schemas and environment rules for accurate results.
May need review before scanning files that contain secrets.
Generated encryption examples need production security review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Configuration
use_cases.description: Validate required values, environment rules, and deployment settings before a release.

use_cases.title: Add Schema-Based Validation
use_cases.description: Create validation schemas and tests for application configuration modules.

use_cases.title: Review Configuration Security
use_cases.description: Identify risky debug flags, weak transport settings, and secret handling gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Config
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one configuration file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this configuration file. Identify missing fields, unsafe defaults, and simple validation rules.

prompt_templates.title: Create Validation Schema
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a schema for known settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a validation schema for these settings. Include required fields, allowed ranges, and clear error messages.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Environments
prompt_templates.scenario: Check development, staging, and production settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these environment configurations. Find inconsistent values, production risks, and rules that should differ by environment.

prompt_templates.title: Design Validation Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a deployment validation workflow. Include schema checks, tests, migration checks, secret redaction, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: Review a production configuration for release readiness.
output_examples.output: A release checklist with required fields, blocked settings, security warnings, and recommended validation tests.

output_examples.input: Create validation rules for database and service settings.
output_examples.output: A schema plan describing field types, required values, valid ranges, and user-friendly error messages.

output_examples.input: Compare development and production configuration behavior.
output_examples.output: A comparison report showing differences in debug mode, transport security, credentials, and migration readiness.

best_practices: Define explicit schemas before deploying new configuration fields.
Keep production rules stricter than development rules.
Redact secrets from reports, logs, and validation errors.
anti_patterns: Do not validate production configuration with development-only rules.
Do not print full configuration objects when errors occur.
Do not scan secret files without explicit approval and redaction.

faq.question: What configuration formats can this skill discuss?
faq.answer: It can discuss common formats such as JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, environment files, and JavaScript configuration.

faq.question: Can it create executable validators?
faq.answer: It can draft validator designs and examples. Review and test all generated code before using it in deployment.

faq.question: Does it handle production security rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest rules for HTTPS, debug settings, password length, encryption, and secret redaction.

faq.question: Can it compare environment files?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the relevant files or summaries, and ask for environment differences and release risks.

faq.question: Should it inspect secret files?
faq.answer: Only with explicit approval. Secret values should be redacted from prompts, logs, and generated reports.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
